Dell boosted its fiscal year revenue sales outlook for the third time due to surging server sales fueled by the build-out of AI data centers. He speaks on "Balance of Power: Evening Edition." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Kinship Ventures Co-Founders Gwyneth Paltrow & Moj Mahdara on Partnership & Portfolio Strategy
general.summary: Gwyneth Paltrow, Co-Founder & General Partner of Kinship Ventures and CEO and Founder of Goop Inc, and Moj Mahdara, Co-Founder & Managing Partner of Kinship Ventures, joined Bloomberg’s Romaine Bostick to discuss the venture capital firm’s approach to early and late stage investing, the names in their portfolio, the future of wellness and more. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Butterball CEO on Thanksgiving Dinner Outlook
general.summary: Jay Jandrain, Butterball CEO, says U.S. turkey production is slightly higher than last year and holiday turkey prices are broadly consistent with prior years. Some retailers are offering turkey deals below last year’s prices, and Thanksgiving meal baskets may cost the same or less. Jandrain says retailers decide whether to discount products to attract shoppers, while Butterball welcomes the promotions. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: J.P. Morgan Asset Mgmt’s Rosenbaum on 2027 AI Spend
general.summary: Nathaniel Rosenbaum, JPMorgan’s Head of U.S. High-Grade Credit Strategy, expects another busy year of AI-related borrowing but says issuance growth could crest during 2027. High-grade supply surged nearly three and a half times this year, he said; next year, it could reach a record $2.1 trillion without repeating that jump. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: AI Pullback Raises the Cost of Data Center Financing
general.summary: The recent pullback in AI stocks is spilling into credit markets, making some data center financing more expensive even as demand for computing power remains strong. MUFG Americas CFO Mark Thumser says lenders are becoming more selective and investors are demanding wider spreads and better terms. general.title: Defensive Assets Are Springing to Life: Emily Roland
general.summary: Emily Roland, Co-Chief Investment Strategist at Manulife John Hancock Investments, argues that the Federal Reserve is central to the outlook for equities as momentum in the AI trade slows and markets need a stronger macro cycle to advance. She says investors need a Fed “put,” not only support from Trump-related policy, and describes the Fed as a key market problem. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Stock Losses Build as AI Trade Falters, Oil Drops: Markets Wrap
general.summary: Stocks sold off and futures signaled further weakness as doubts over the durability of the artificial intelligence boom drove a retreat from technology shares. Treasuries advanced on haven demand.
